The statement total is the p10 proprietary statement: Cost of purchased power 250,661.10 + Total operating expenses 652,517.32 (incl. Depreciation 145,388.00) + Interest expense 18,855.95 = 922,034.37. Per fund, p10 vs p13: Electric 466,900.72 vs 483,562.05 (+16,661.33), Water 183,985.52 vs 182,997.53 (-987.99), Sewer 53,321.20 vs 54,271.54 (+950.34), Waste 217,826.93 vs 177,087.36 (-40,739.57); net -24,115.89 = the gap. The budget basis excludes depreciation and includes capital purchases/debt principal (p11 cash paid for property 17,993.23, debt principal 97,716.25), so the two printed totals really differ. No fix.
